mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline from selecting an ADU floor plan to completing construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline from selecting an ADU floor plan to construction completion can vary based on plan complexity, permitting processes, and site conditions. Generally, it takes approximately 1-3 months for design finalization and permitting approval. Construction itself typically spans 4-8 months, depending on the ADU's size and features. External factors like material availability or inspection schedules can also influence the total duration. Zen Tiny Homes provides a detailed project schedule once a plan is selected.
acceptedAnswer.description: From plan selection to construction completion, an ADU project typically takes 5-11 months. This includes 1-3 months for design and permitting, and 4-8 months for construction.
